kanto.flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

original-johto.flavorText: It wraps its op­ ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

hoenn.flavorText: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY’s gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon born from poison gases. It defeats even the largest foes by enveloping them in gas.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

original-unova.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

updated-unova.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

kalos.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

original-alola.flavorText: Although Gastly is barely visible, when it’s near, a faint sweet smell lingers.

updated-alola.flavorText: Poisonous gas comprises 95% of its body. It’s said that the remaining 5% is made up of the souls of those who died from the gas.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.

swsh.flavorText: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

pla.flavorText: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.
